都说帅不过三秒，不亲身经历谁也不知道是什么感觉。当火车站四面八方的人齐刷刷的看向王野时，饶是两世为人的他也面红耳赤，落荒而逃。

跑到一个没人的巷子，王野从空间中取出一个麻袋，这里的有他头天晚上整理出来的东西：三十年的人参十支，其他低年份的一小袋子，干榛蘑，干木耳，榛子，松子，黑市上换的飞龙，还有熊肉和一只熊掌。

这两样王野都在空间里进行了脱水处理，也不知道味道怎么样。但是为了掩人耳目，也只能够这样了。总不能这么热的天气，从东北拿回来的肉，一点都没变质吧。

还有就是那张熊皮，这东西给赵爷爷做个褥子，冬天一定暖和。至于爷爷奶奶和太爷爷，那就找机会拿两张老虎皮吧，在乡下注意点儿还是能瞒得住的。

王野扛着一个大麻袋，虽说对于他来说并不是很重，但是太显眼儿了，在不远处王野招呼过来了一个人力平板三轮，在这个运输能力不足的时代，有一群人，拉动了四九城的交通运输，他们就是板爷。

坐在板儿车上，王野一手扶着麻袋，一手扶着车板儿。这时候的板儿爷，可不像后世的出租车司机，总有聊不完的天。他们得尽可能的节省力气，所以一路上除了问路，一般不会和王野闲聊。

全程不过五六公里，大概四十来分钟王野就到了家门口。看见小丫头王笑笑正蹲在墙根儿处自己玩儿，王野没等三轮停下就从车上跳了下来，悄悄的走到王笑笑身后，聚精会神玩儿的小丫头没有发现他。

王野蹲下，轻轻碰了一下小丫头的后背。王笑笑这才转过身来，猛然间看见身后是自己心心念念的大锅。

小丫头原本灵动的眼眸，此刻蓄满了泪水，像快要决堤的小湖。一见到王野，嘴巴瞬间撇成了小月牙，“哇”地放声大哭起来，小身子剧烈地颤抖着，不顾一切地扑进王野怀里，边哭边含糊地嘟囔：“大锅，大锅。”

王野轻轻的拍着小丫头的后背，眼睛也红红的嘟囔着：“不哭，不哭啊，大哥回来了，大哥回来了。”

王笑笑紧紧的抱住王野的脖子，用出了她最大的力气，生怕一松手大哥又走了。王野抱起王笑笑，对着坐在门边的李奶奶打招呼：“李奶奶，好呀，想我了吗？”

李奶奶早就看见王野了，只是看人家兄妹重逢没有上去打扰。见王野打招呼了，也笑着说道：“小野出差回来啦，你这一走时间可不短呀？”

王野：“可不呢！十来天了。”

李奶奶：“快快，回家吧，你娘都念叨你好几次了。”

王野：“好嘞，李奶奶先歇着，我先回屋了。”

说完给了板儿也运费，单手背上麻袋就进了院子。院里秦婉，李婶，刘婶正在一起洗着衣服聊着家常，三人同时抬头看见王野一手抱着王笑笑，背着一个大麻袋。

秦婉目光紧紧锁住王野，像是要把十来天的思念都看回来，眼中饱含着心疼与关切，微微泛红。她上下打量着王野，嘴角始终挂着笑意，那笑容里满是安心。

王野看着母亲，脸上带着温暖的笑意，眼中闪烁着明亮的光芒。微微歪着头，嘴角轻轻上扬，露出一口洁白的牙齿，用带着些疲惫却又欢快的语调说：“娘，我回来啦！”

秦婉上前要接过王野的麻袋，她哪儿拎得动呀，赶紧放在地上：“娘，这个挺沉的。”

秦婉就这么直勾勾的看着王野，嘴里嘟囔着：“回来就好，回来就好。”

They say you can only be handsome for three seconds, and no one knows what it feels like unless you experience it yourself.When people from all sides of the train station looked at Wang Ye, even though he was a man of two generations, he blushed and ran away.

Running to a deserted alley, Wang Ye took out a sack from the space. Here were the things he had sorted out the night before: ten ginseng sticks aged thirty years, a small bag of other low-year vintages, dried hazel mushrooms, dried fungus, hazelnuts, pine nuts, flying dragons traded on the black market, as well as bear meat and a bear paw.

Wang Ye had dehydrated both of them in space, and he didn't know how they tasted.But in order to deceive others, this is the only way.It can't be that in such hot weather, the meat brought back from the Northeast has not spoiled at all.

There is also the bear skin. This thing can be used as a mattress for Grandpa Zhao. It will definitely keep him warm in winter.As for the grandparents and great-grandfather, let's find an opportunity to get two tiger skins. If you are careful in the countryside, you can still hide them.

Wang Ye was carrying a large sack. Although it was not very heavy for him, it was too conspicuous. Not far away, Wang Ye called over a human-powered flatbed tricycle. In this era of insufficient transportation capacity, there is a group of people who have promoted the transportation of Sijiu City. They are Ban Ye.

Sitting on the cart, Wang Ye held the sack with one hand and the cart with the other.At this time, Mr. Ban'er was not like the taxi drivers of later generations, who always had endless chats.They have to save energy as much as possible, so apart from asking for directions along the way, they usually don't chat with Wang Ye.

The whole journey was only five or six kilometers, and Wang Ye arrived at his door in about forty minutes.Seeing the little girl Wang Xiaoxiao squatting at the base of the wall and playing by herself, Wang Ye jumped out of the car before the tricycle stopped and walked quietly behind Wang Xiaoxiao. The little girl was so focused on playing that she didn't notice him.

Wang Ye knelt down and gently touched the little girl's back.Wang Xiaoxiao turned around and suddenly saw behind him the cauldron that he had longed for.

The little girl's originally bright eyes were now filled with tears, like a small lake about to burst its banks.As soon as he saw Wang Ye, his mouth turned into a small crescent moon, and he burst into tears "Wow". His little body trembled violently, and he desperately threw himself into Wang Ye's arms, crying and mumbling vaguely: "Big pot, big pot."

Wang Ye patted the little girl's back gently, and murmured with red eyes: "Don't cry, don't cry, big brother is back, big brother is back."

Wang Xiaoxiao hugged Wang Ye's neck tightly and used her greatest strength, fearing that her brother would leave again if she let go.Wang Ye picked up Wang Xiaoxiao and greeted Grandma Li who was sitting by the door: "Grandma Li, okay, do you miss me?"

Grandma Li had seen Wang Ye a long time ago, but she didn't bother her because she saw the brother and sister reunited.Seeing Wang Ye saying hello, he also smiled and said: "Xiaoye is back from a business trip. You have been gone for a long time, haven't you?"

Wang Ye: "No! It's been ten days."

Grandma Li: "Hurry up, go home, your mother has been talking about you several times."

Wang Ye: "Okay, Grandma Li, rest first, I'll go back to the house first."

After saying that, he gave Ban'er the freight, put the sack on one hand and entered the yard.In the courtyard, Qin Wan, Aunt Li, and Aunt Liu were washing clothes together and chatting about home affairs. The three of them looked up at the same time and saw Wang Ye holding Wang Xiaoxiao in one hand and carrying a large sack on his back.

Qin Wan's eyes were locked on Wang Ye tightly, as if she wanted to bring back all the thoughts she had missed for ten days. Her eyes were full of heartache and concern, and were slightly red.She looked Wang Ye up and down, with a smile on her lips that was full of reassurance.

Wang Ye looked at his mother with a warm smile on his face and a bright light in his eyes.He tilted his head slightly, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing his white teeth, and said in a tired but cheerful tone: "Mom, I'm back!"

Qin Wan stepped forward to take Wang Ye's sack. She couldn't carry it, so she quickly put it on the ground: "Mom, this is quite heavy."

Qin Wan looked straight at Wang Ye and muttered: "It'll be good to come back, it'll be good to come back."
